### Load packages
Now we will load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
```

### Load data
```{r}
filepath <- here("data","difference_data.xlsx")
penguins <- read_excel(filepath,"penguins")
glimpse(penguins)
```

### Summarise data
```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean_bill_length=mean(bill_length_mm),sd_bill_length=sd(bill_length_mm))
```

### Fipenguins |>

```{r}
adelie <- penguins |>
  filter(species == "Adelie")
glimpse(adelie)
```

### Plot Adelie data
```{r}
adelie |>
  ggplot(aes(x=island, y=bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Island",
       y = "Bill length (mm)") +
  theme_classic()
```
